name: skills-cookbook
description: Ready-to-paste example prompts across fourteen tracks, including decision-native recipes for senior-prompt-engineer, skills-selector, smart-dispatch, and smart-sub-agents, plus typed decisions. Ships verifiable prompt templates, combination rules, anti-patterns, and a complete A-to-Z catalog index. Use when the user asks for examples, how to use or combine skills, portable subagent routing, or how to navigate the catalog with less cognitive load.
